safe.notes: Unpowered island with every core-domain input, phase and code high: no rail back-feed, inputs draw no current (word inputs are buffered, all control inputs are MOS gates), outputs clamped by ISLAND_OFF. Reset defaults (SER_EN=0, WTX_EXT=0, EN_*=0): every command output and tail bias held low; the only static current is the bias mirror when an enable is set. Safety corners ff/85 C/3.63 V included. Mutual exclusion of MAIN/TMDS/POST is the pads interlock (EN_* inputs); this block gates each branch with its enable and selects serializer vs external data break-before-make.

excluded_coverage: Pad-integration runs use the pads family extracted netlists read-only and their recorded patched ngspice-47; termination common mode is an ideal 1.65 V source (pads termination buffer not included); bond 1 ohm / 1 nH per leg; no package model beyond that.
Extraction is capacitance only (no distributed resistance).
The 20-bit word source is ideal PWL launched T_word/4 after WORD_CLK; the standard-cell pattern RTL (rtl/pt_pattern.sv) is not co-simulated.

Ring phases are ideal 50 % duty, exactly 90 deg apart, tanh edges (10-90 % 50 ps) through 150 ohm; ring jitter (except the 2 ps rms RJ budget added to TJ), phase-spacing error and the clockmux are not included.  The core needs <= ~10 ps phase-to-phase skew (interface WT2).

Stimuli are breakpoint-free behavioural sources (tanh edges) behind 150 ohm (phases) / 1 kohm (word bits, controls) driver resistances.  Ideal PWL/PULSE sources made ngspice abort at source corners (C/h-dominated branch currents could not converge to abstol); no simulator tolerance was changed.
The serializer bench loads each tail-bias node with its pad tail device (drain tied to source); tail currents are measured by the DC benches (dac_tt, quiescent), not in the transient runs.
Envelope runs use 200 bits (>1.5 PRBS7 periods), nominal/integration 280 bits: error-free windows, not a measured BER; TJ(1e-12) = simulated DJ_pp + 14.07 x 2 ps rms ring RJ budget.
Rate sweep at tt only; envelope sets as listed under clean.corner_sets.
No Monte Carlo, aging, EM/IR or antenna analysis; density fill is left to top-level assembly.
